label: observed
attribution: Provincia autonoma di Bolzano - Alto Adige, Cartografia provinciale - P_BZ Carta geologica CARG - CC0 1.0
coverage_note: Province of Bolzano / South Tyrol only. 697 tiles carry data, 2840 tiles inside the Dolomites bbox are empty because they sit in Trentino, Belluno, Switzerland or Austria. Other provinces still use the WMS overlays declared in wms.json.

properties_schema.age_min_ma: younger bound: end_ma of the ICS interval (chart 2026-06) named in ETA_CODICE_MIN_IT (names ordered by chart age where the source fields are swapped); null if that string is absent or unmapped
properties_schema.age_max_ma: older bound: start_ma of the ICS interval (chart 2026-06) named in ETA_CODICE_MAX_IT (names ordered by chart age where the source fields are swapped); null if that string is absent or unmapped. age_min_ma <= age_max_ma
properties_schema.age_label: original Italian age strings 'older - younger' (ETA_CODICE_MAX_IT - ETA_CODICE_MIN_IT, reordered by chart age where the source fields are swapped; one string when both are equal), with the source qualifiers (p.p.) = pro parte and (?) = uncertain
properties_schema.lithology: unit-type label from TEG_DESC_I (e.g. 'unita geologica di base')
properties_schema.color: ICS chart 2026-06 colour of the unit's youngest named interval (ETA_CODICE_MIN_IT, or ETA_CODICE_MAX_IT where the source fields are swapped), at the rank the string names: stage colour for a stage, series colour for a series, period colour for a period; null if that string is absent or unmapped (never borrowed from the older bound)

verification.method: decode one z=11 tile at bbox centre; count distinct unit_name values and the most common age attributes

ages.derivation: age_min_ma, age_max_ma and color derived from the stage/series/period names in the map attributes ETA_CODICE_MIN_IT and ETA_CODICE_MAX_IT via the ICS International Chronostratigraphic Chart version 2026-06
ages.ics_chart: app/public/data/ics-chart.json; intervals older than 300 Ma from the same chart file data/raw/ics-2026/chart-official/chart.ttl
ages.honesty_note: The polygons and their stratigraphic attributions are the map's (observed). The numeric ages and colours are the ICS chart's boundary ages and colours for the named intervals, not ages measured or published by the map. Strings qualified (p.p.) or (?) mean the unit occupies only part of, or is uncertainly attributed to, the interval, so age_min_ma/age_max_ma are an outer envelope. Where the source lists the younger name in ETA_CODICE_MAX_IT (see swapped_age_field_pairs), the two names are ordered by chart age before the range and colour are taken.

Carbonifero superiore.reason: The ICS chart has no 'Upper Carboniferous' unit: the Carboniferous is split into the Mississippian and Pennsylvanian subperiods, each with its own Lower/Middle/Upper series, and the traditional European Upper Carboniferous (Silesian) begins below the base of the Pennsylvanian. The older bound depends on which convention the map uses.

Terziario (?).reason: Tertiary is not a unit of the ICS chart (replaced by Paleogene + Neogene), and its upper bound depends on whether the pre-2009 or the current base of the Quaternary is meant.
